cases.title: Every new top-level model-space object (pit, pit label, cover text, pipe, pipe label, IL text and flow arrow) lands on its office layer, nothing lands on layer 0 or the current layer, and the current layer stays BLOCKS throughout
cases.plan_item: UX-LYR-01 office layers, the layer of every new top-level model-space object (daily card D24 assertion 2, for this ordinary pipe and labelled pit only)
cases.expected: Running snaps off. PIT at 150000,-80000 with cover level 19.000, the label point clicked at 150000,-78500 and the cover point at 150000,-78510 (N25's route), then CD from 150000,-80000 to 170000,-80000 with inverts 18.000 / 17.900 and one Esc. CLAYER reads BLOCKS at the start, after the pit and after the pipe. Exactly 8 new top-level model-space objects: one pit on STORMWATER PIT, one PIT LABEL block on STORMWATER PIT LABEL, one 'CL 19.000' text on 25TEXT, one pipe on STORMWATER PIPE, one pipe label on 25TEXT, two IL texts on 20TEXT, one flow arrow (TIM_CVL_ARROW) on ARROW; none on layer 0 or on BLOCKS.
cases.why_not_unit: Layer choice happens in the live drawing's layer table as the real PIT and CD commands write each object.
not_automated: 'An existing layer is never recoloured' is NOT BUILT (card D24 correction 3); the layer table colours are not read (no verb reads a layer table record).

Card wording: 'IL texts and the label are on the pipe-text layer'. The product uses 20TEXT for IL texts and 25TEXT for the pipe label (LayerService.cs); this case checks those two, which is the product as built, not a guess.
The current layer after each Esc path is N28's part (five endings); here it is read at three points of a normal run.
Block contents and attribute layers are not read; layer-table colours and linetypes are not read.

cases.title: Pits typed as LPD, OG, CP2 and CP10 are listed in the Pit Schedule in CE's group order: LPD, OG, the P pits by number, CP2 then CP10, then the rest (C1)
cases.plan_item: UX-SCHED-06 Pit Schedule order, the group order (daily card D21 assertion 3; Tim's switch linking.pitScheduleNaturalOrder OFF)
cases.expected: Four pits placed with PIT, each with the pit number typed in New Pit (LPD at 152000,-80000, OG at 154000,-80000, CP10 at 156000,-80000, CP2 at 158000,-80000; cover 19.000; three Esc each) print 'Pit placed successfully.' four times. The Pit Schedule then lists LPD, OG, P1, P2, P3, P4, P5, P6, P7, P9, P10, CP2, CP10, C1 in that order; CP10 is never above CP2 and no P pit is above LPD or OG.
cases.why_not_unit: The order shown depends on the live schedule window reading the real pits after live placements with typed numbers.
not_automated: The P1A / SPS refinement (switch on) is N34. Assertions 1 and 2 (a new P pit takes its number's place) are N29.
Card wording 'LPD, OG': the source groups a pit named exactly LPD or OG; a pit named LPD1 or OG2 sorts with 'the rest'. This case uses the exact names.
CP10 is placed before CP2 on purpose, so a list in placing order would put CP10 first and fail.
